issue_request: FHIR-46412 was Applied/Persuasive by Patient Administration after a 4-0-0 vote. It requested a token genderIdentity search parameter for the individual-genderIdentity extension, with bases Patient, RelatedPerson, Person, Practitioner, and PractitionerRole and expression extension('http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/individual-genderIdentity').extension('value').value.
initial_application: No core FHIR commit mentions FHIR-46412. FHIR Extension Pack commit ac5423bbfd2385f94ed0be8dde9746d2517bf5b0 added input/definitions/multiple/SearchParameter-individual-genderIdentity.xml, and later Extension Pack commits changed only title and experimental metadata.
additional_context: The Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* as resource input and defines search-params.html as the Extension Search Registry. The core search parameter registry already directs extension-associated search parameters to that external registry, and core source contains only existing individual-genderIdentity links, examples, and OID references. PA Confluence minutes confirm the persuasive vote; no exact-key Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because the requested artifact is owned by the Extension Pack and the read-only Extension Pack checkout already contains the matching build-scope SearchParameter.
